_nota: Contraparte en inglés de design_hypotheses.json (2026-11-15): el enunciado de cada hipótesis, qué hace cada pieza de EMMA por ella, los datos reales y lo que EMMA no demuestra. El enunciado literal es el castellano de la base de conocimiento del equipo; este es su traducción, y la nota servida lo dice. El inglés no afirma más: ninguna hipótesis figura como probada. Los identificadores, los módulos, las rutas y el título del apartado no se traducen. El fichero castellano es el que se valida y no cambia.

strings.Existe todavía un hueco entre datos médi: There is still a gap between heterogeneous medical/environmental data and a personalized, longitudinal and explainable on-board decision layer.
strings.El baseline individual y la tendencia so: The individual baseline and the trend are more useful for certain signals than comparing only against population ranges.
strings.Algunas variables clínicas costosas pued: Some costly clinical variables can be partially inferred from low-cost operational signals; it has to be demonstrated domain by domain.
strings.Correlacionar cambios simultáneos de var: Correlating simultaneous changes in several crew members with habitat telemetry can improve the isolation of the cause.
strings.Un Countermeasure Twin que conozca recur: A Countermeasure Twin that knows resources, protocols and prior response adds more value than an isolated alert.
strings.La radiación ofrece un buen caso end-to-: Radiation offers a good end-to-end case for a demo because it connects hazard, dosimetry, accumulated exposure, context, action and follow-up.
strings.La alimentación puede ser un segundo cas: Food can be a second case because it is an everyday countermeasure that interacts with resources, microbiome, metabolism and acceptability.
strings.MMASH: 22 personas sanas, 24 h, en Tierr: MMASH: 22 healthy people, 24 h, on Earth. On that physiology, the false-alarm rate and the sensitivity to injected deteriorations, which are parametric and not clinical cases, are measured together. It is not flight physiology.
strings.Registro encadenado y firmado por el que: Chained and signed record through which every observation enters, whatever source it comes from.
strings.Un único estado por tripulante, con el m: A single state per crew member, with the reason for each level.
strings.Cita los huecos Med 07 y Med 10 tal como: It cites gaps Med 07 and Med 10 as stated by NTRS 20200000567 (2020), next to the status the Human Research Roadmap publishes today: Med 07 closed and Med 10 merged into Medical-701.
strings.Lo leído en las fuentes de NASA el 2026-: What was read in NASA's sources on 2026-10-13, with its sentence and its address: the ExMC CDSS architecture, the status of Med 07 (closed) and of Med 10 (merged into Medical-701) according to the Human Research Roadmap, and the limitations NASA declares for the IMM.
strings.Línea base personal móvil por indicador;: Moving personal baseline per indicator; without it only absolute danger limits are watched, and the state says which of the two paths it rests on.
strings.Carga MMASH para las pruebas marcadas `e: Loads MMASH for the tests marked `external`.
strings.Inyecta deterioros de magnitud conocida: Injects deteriorations of known magnitude on that same physiology to measure sensitivity.
strings.Banda de pérdida de densidad mineral óse: Band of bone mineral density loss labeled «inferred»: a population band applied to the mission day, not an estimate from this crew member's signals.
strings.Cada observación declara si es medida, i: Each observation declares whether it is measured, inferred or predicted.
strings.Coste de medir de cada indicador, para d: Cost of measuring each indicator, to tell what can be watched daily from what requires a laboratory.
strings.Con dos o más tripulantes fuera de nomin: With two or more crew members off nominal and a cabin excursion in the same window, it proposes the shared environmental context first, labeled as a hypothesis.
strings.El mismo indicador en cada tripulante co: The same indicator in each crew member against their own baseline, with the cabin parameter on the same axis.
strings.Una persona confirma o descarta la hipót: A person confirms or discards the shared-cause hypothesis, signed.
strings.Atmósfera de cabina simulada, con valore: Simulated cabin atmosphere, with declared design values.
strings.Biblioteca de contramedidas como datos:: Library of countermeasures as data: indication, resources it asks for, crew time, protocol or source, and follow-up; what has no source says so.
strings.Adopción y cierre firmados por una perso: Adoption and closure signed by a person; the follow-up status is derived from the data.
strings.Junto a cada recomendación, lo que pasó: Next to each recommendation, what happened the other times that countermeasure was adopted, with the warning that it is not proof of cause.
strings.Recursos que una persona declara disponi: Resources that a person declares available or not, over the vocabulary the countermeasures name; each recommendation says what it asks for and what is missing or undeclared.
strings.Dosis equivalente a partir de dosimetría: Dose equivalent from ISS dosimetry, declaring whether it is measured or estimated and with which quality factor.
strings.Tres escalas: aguda con su tiempo hasta: Three scales: acute with its time to action, mission (inferred) and career against the limit.
strings.Refugio frente a la tormenta como contra: Shelter from the storm as a structured countermeasure, with its follow-up.
strings.Dominio de nutrición: ingesta energética: Nutrition domain: energy intake, acceptability, appetite and fraction of the ration left uneaten, with EMMA's own codes and their justification.
strings.Escenario de fatiga de menú, con su pará: Menu-fatigue scenario, with its drift parameter classified «unsupported in what was read» (until 2026-10-26, «contested»).
strings.Cada valoración de la comida por debajo: Each food rating below 6.0 marked «below the acceptability criterion for food», with the sentence from NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 2 [V2 7002] and its page. A mark on the food: it does not enter any level or alert.
strings.Que el hueco siga abierto hoy, ni que EM: That the gap is still open today, or that EMMA closes it. Read on 2026-10-13: the Human Research Roadmap publishes Med07 as closed («NASA now has the capability to comprehensively process medically-relevant information to support medical operations during exploration missions») and Med10 as merged into Medical-701, which remains open. The three references of the ExMC CDSS architecture have been read (of the 2021 one, the one-page abstract, which is what NTRS offers) and describe what NASA asks of that system, not a gap that EMMA fills. What NASA considers closed or open is its own capability: EMMA has not been evaluated against those documents. The concept of operations HRP-48033 and the requirements HRP-48034 and HRP-48035 remain not read, and of the IMM only its public pages and Appendix E of the standard have been read. It remains a hypothesis: having read the documents does not prove it.
strings.Que la línea base personal sea más útil: That the personal baseline is more useful than a population range in flight: EMMA has no comparison of the two paths on real flight data. The external-validation document itself declares that, with 24 h per subject, MMASH barely exercises the personal-baseline path and that it does not validate flight drift.
strings.Que alguna variable costosa se pueda inf: That any costly variable can be inferred from low-cost signals: EMMA has no model that does so, nor data to check it against, in any domain. The bone band does not narrow with the recorded exercise, and it says so: since 2026-10-10 what is measured of the exercise (minutes and impacts of the last week) is shown next to the band, labeled as measured, without modifying it.
strings.Que la correlación mejore el aislamiento: That the correlation improves the isolation of the cause. In the simulated scenario the common cause is put there by construction, and there are no real data from several crew members with habitat telemetry. The output is a coincidence in time, not proof of causality.
strings.Que añada más valor que una alerta aisla: That it adds more value than an isolated alert: there is no comparison and no user study. Of the on-board resources EMMA only knows what a person declares, resource by resource, over a closed vocabulary: it keeps no inventory or quantities, and what is not declared is not taken as available. The prior response is descriptive: next to each recommendation it shows how many times that countermeasure was adopted before for that crew member, how it was closed and what its follow-up evaluated; it compares levels over time, without a control group, and it is not proof of efficacy and does not change what is recommended.
strings.«Buen caso para demo» es un juicio de di: «A good case for a demo» is a design judgment, not something EMMA measures. The event of the scenario is simulated; the real dosimetry is from the ISS, not from a crew member of this mission; the mission dose is inferred and the career dose depends on a prior dose that someone declares.
strings.Que la fatiga de menú ocurra, ni que la: That menu fatigue occurs, or that food works as a countermeasure: the scenario is a simulated hypothesis. EMMA does not model inventory, shelf life, microbiome or metabolism, and acceptability is a guide about the food, not a threshold on the person. The Human Research Roadmap gap on menu fatigue, FN-205, is listed as archived and removed from the current research plan (read on 2026-10-13): the scenario does not answer an open NASA gap.
